_comment: ESP32-S3 HT40 capture with null subcarriers masked out.
Live frames are 192 bins; 26 are always-zero DC/guard nulls
previously emitted .take(56), keeping 12 nulls and discarding 122
usable bins - 26.5% of the signal. native == num means no resampling:
the model sees every measured bin.
n_rx = 3 is the three ESP32 nodes on the node axis (time_node_major).
